provenance.statement: Supercell describes Super Bowler as one extra bounce for three impacts, establishing two for Bowler. A dated secondary build documents the second building behind the target and the three-tile initial range. Core uses that range as a forward-step proxy and keeps a zero-radius lower bound.
provenance.needed: Measured bounce path and spacing, splash radius, collision, flight, intermediate target loss, walls, target eligibility and tick ordering

historical_unavailable_profiles.reason: No reproducible historical v18.200.9 Bowler bounce-flight profile has been curated. The current two-impact lower bound must not infer exact bounce geometry or timing.

test_evidence: cocsim_bowler_tests: two fixed impact centres, no third Super Bowler impact, snapshot restoration and replay retain the future hash.
